facts.fact: PAFEN issued on 23 September 2026 a World Bank-financed request for proposals to design, build and deploy an end-to-end electronic public procurement (e-GP) system for Burundi, proposals due 13 November 2026.

systems.owner: Ministry of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy / ARMP

BDI.note: Notice concerns public procurement only; no business register stated.
Notice is a procurement tender for a back-office system; no citizen-facing online service stated.
Notice does not mention a national ID system.
A supplier will build the e-GP alongside ARMP's team with skills transfer, which is a contractor build; no government-run or government-built system is stated.
